title: Word-aligned 64-bit product with a rank-one four-circulant parity retune

claims.statement: For the explicit product of 31 systematic [64,32] components and one [16,8] tail, and the counted marked-syndrome decoder of proof.md, the average block error for uniform 1000-bit data on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses is at most 24997170494903240045979419145759/25000000000000000000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder uses exactly W=283 primitives on every received word and W<=2^(295871/36327).

experiments.purpose: Verify complete exact syndrome leader and reserved-address histograms in each invariant sector, exact product bound, and the fixed schedule in sector zero.
